title: 3Sum

statement.hi: Integer array `nums` diya hai. Saare triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` return karo jahan `i`, `j`, `k` alag hon aur `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`. Answer me **duplicate triplets nahi** hone chahiye. Triplets aur unke andar ke numbers kisi bhi order me ho sakte hain.
statement.en: Given an integer array `nums`, return all triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` with `i`, `j`, `k` distinct and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`. The answer must **not contain duplicate triplets**. Triplets and the numbers inside them may be in any order.

hi: Ek number fix karo, baaki do ke liye two pointers chalao.
Duplicates se bachne ke liye same value wale elements skip karo.
en: Fix one number and run two pointers for the other two.
Skip elements equal to the previous one to avoid duplicate triplets.

approach.hi: Sort karo. Har `i` ke liye (duplicate `nums[i]` skip karke) `l = i+1`, `h = n-1` se two pointers chalao: sum chhota to `l++`, bada to `h--`, zero to triplet save karo aur dono taraf duplicates skip karo. O(n^2) time, sort ke alawa O(1) extra space.
approach.en: Sort. For each `i` (skipping duplicate `nums[i]`), run two pointers `l = i+1`, `h = n-1`: sum too small → `l++`, too big → `h--`, zero → record the triplet and skip duplicates on both sides. O(n^2) time, O(1) extra space besides sorting.
